title: Sum Multiples
summary: For a positive integer n, calculate the sum of all integers from 1 to n that are divisible by 3, 5, or 7.
statement: For a positive integer n, calculate the sum of all integers from 1 to n that are divisible by 3, 5, or 7. Return the sum as an integer.
constraints: Consider every positive integer from one through n inclusive.
Return their sum, counting a value only once even if several divisors divide it.
hints: The sum of positive multiples of d through n is d times the triangular number through floor(n/d).
Add the sums for divisors three, five, and seven.
Subtract pairwise least-common-multiple sums and restore the triple intersection at 105.
Inclusion-exclusion gives every selected integer coefficient one regardless of how many base divisors divide it.
editorial: Inclusion-exclusion gives every selected integer coefficient one regardless of how many base divisors divide it.

tests.explanation: The selected values are three, five, six, and seven, whose sum is twenty-one.
Adding three, five, six, seven, nine, and ten gives forty.
